title: 第7章 越狱第8章 踏狱而出避谁锋芒
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
穷凶极恶的罪犯，在厮杀，以最原始的方式厮杀。
群魔乱舞，死亡的乐章。
瘫坐在血泊中的青莲，嘴唇哆嗦着，涣散的眼神呆滞的望着夜洐。
望着漫步在地牢中，聆听动听乐章的夜洐。
嘴里发出含混不清的细碎声音：“魔....邪魔....你是邪魔.....”
“不是你们逼着？”夜洐微笑的看着她：“谁不想站在太阳下，行走在正道上，有两三红颜知己，几个兄弟，与人把酒言欢，闲暇时做做好事，逍遥世间。”
“我也想，我也是如此做的，是你们不给我机会，逼着我成魔的，不是吗？”
青莲张着嘴动了动，无言以对，眼神躲闪，躲开夜洐的目光。
“邪魔，人人得而诛之，你出不去的，你逃不出去。”
“你夜洐天赋再高，两年前你才刚入第二境，在地牢没有天材地宝的供养，你坠入魔道又如何，不可能现在有第四境的实力，没有第四境，一点越狱的机会都没有，你出不去的，你休想去报复公主殿下。”
青莲歇斯底里的说着，表情似哭似笑。
“这些罪犯，就算有第四境的狠人，可长年累月气海被封，短时间根本恢复不了实力，掌狱人实打实的第四境强者，还有四境大妖。”
青莲怨毒的眼神中，充满了畅快得意。
仿佛已经看到，夜洐死在这里的画面。
夜洐淡淡道：“第四境，那就入了吧。”
夜洐缓缓抬手，五指向虚空一握。
一声巨响，整个地牢剧烈震颤，阴冷暴戾的血煞各种玄气，混杂在一起，疯狂向夜洐涌入。
十数种阴寒玄气，尽数融入夜洐体内，一道道黑色的魔纹似毒虬密布全身。
夜洐眼眸，被漆黑的魔气所覆盖，目光所向。
玄铁牢门腐朽崩塌。

厮杀的罪犯们身上的锁链崩裂。
地牢百年不见阳光蕴含的阴煞玄气，经过厮杀产生的死气、怨气、杀气......。
被夜洐身后凝聚而成的数丈魔影所吞噬。
吞噬一切。
咔嚓。
迈入第四境的壁垒，在魔气霸道的冲击下，崩碎了。
夜洐身后的魔影更加凝练，魔眼流动着赤金色流光，跳动的心脏闪耀湛蓝色的雷霆。
青莲僵硬原地，眼睛瞪得滚圆。
夜洐身后的灭世大魔，仿佛连她的灵魂都吞噬掉了。
当她看到，夜洐身后灭世大魔虚影，慢慢双膝跪地，双手托起夜洐，夜洐站在魔影之上，凌空！
凌空代表着第四境。
第四境“万御境”，可统御玄气，御气而行。
青莲灵魂深处都在恐惧。
“青莲姐，别怕，我跟你们不一样，两年前你们没有给我选择的余地，我就不同，不像你们那么霸道无情，我给你选择，给你做主的机会。”
尽管只是夜洐随意一瞥。
青莲忍不住发出恐惧的爆鸣声。
“我....我....我不能背叛公主，我.....”
“青莲姐，我怎么可能强人所难。”
青莲长松一口气。
“这场游戏，也包括你，只要你是剩余四人，可活。”

青莲刚刚露出一点笑容的甜美脸蛋，刹那间脸色白的跟冥纸一样。
一瞬间。
只剩下不到十人的凶人们，一双双杀红眼的凶眼，死盯着青莲。
岂能让人占了便宜。
content_en:
The most vicious criminals are fighting, fighting in the most primitive way.
Demons dance wildly, the music of death.
Qinglian was paralyzed in a pool of blood, her lips were trembling, and she looked at Ye Hao with dull eyes.
Looking at Ye Zhi walking in the dungeon and listening to the beautiful music.
An indistinct and thin voice came out of his mouth: "Demon...evil...you are the evil..."
"Aren't you forcing me?" Ye Tao looked at her with a smile: "Who doesn't want to stand under the sun, walk on the right path, have two or three confidantes, a few brothers, drink and chat with others, do good deeds in their free time, and live in peace in the world."
"I also think that I did the same thing. It was you who didn't give me a chance and forced me to become a demon, wasn't it?"
Qinglian opened her mouth and moved, speechless, her eyes evasive, avoiding Ye Hao's gaze.
"Evils, everyone can find them and kill them. If you can't get out, you can't escape."
"No matter how talented you are in the night, you just entered the second realm two years ago. There are no heavenly materials and earthly treasures to support you in the dungeon. So what if you fall into the devil's way? It is impossible for you to have the strength of the fourth realm now. Without the fourth realm, there is no chance of escaping from prison. If you can't get out, there is no way you can take revenge on Her Highness the Princess."
Qinglian said hysterically, her expression seemed to be crying and laughing.
"These criminals, even if they are ruthless people in the fourth realm, have been blocked for many years, and they cannot recover their strength in a short time. The person in charge of the prison is a real strong man in the fourth realm, and there are also great demons in the fourth realm."
Qinglian's resentful eyes were filled with joy and pride.
It seemed as if he had already seen the scene of Ye Hao dying here.
Ye Huan said calmly: "The fourth realm, then enter."
Ye Hao slowly raised his hand and held his five fingers in the void.
There was a loud noise, and the entire dungeon shook violently. The cold and violent blood evil and various mysterious energies mixed together and poured into Ye Hao crazily.
More than a dozen kinds of cold and cold mysterious energy were all integrated into Ye Hui's body, and black magic lines covered his whole body like poisonous snakes.
Ye Hui's eyes were covered with dark demonic energy, and his gaze was directed towards.
The dark iron prison door decayed and collapsed.
The chains on the fighting criminals broke.
The dark evil energy contained in the dungeon that has not seen sunlight for a hundred years, the death energy, resentment, murderous energy generated by fighting...
He was swallowed up by the several-foot-long demonic shadow condensed behind Ye Wei.
Swallow everything.
Click.
The barrier to the fourth realm collapsed under the overbearing impact of demonic energy.
The demonic shadow behind Ye Tao became more condensed, the demonic eyes were flowing with red-gold light, and the beating heart was shining with azure thunder.
Qinglian froze on the spot, her eyes widened.
The world-destroying demon behind Ye Hui seemed to have swallowed up her soul.
When she saw the shadow of the world-destroying demon behind Ye Hui, she slowly knelt down on her knees and held up Ye Hui with both hands. Ye Hui stood on top of the demon shadow, flying in the air!
The volley represents the fourth realm.
The fourth realm, "Ten Thousand Imperial Realms", can control the mysterious energy and move with it.
Qinglian's soul was filled with fear.
"Sister Qinglian, don't be afraid. I'm different from you. You didn't give me a choice two years ago. I'm different. I'm not as domineering and ruthless as you. I give you a choice and a chance to make the decision."
Even though it was just a casual glance from Ye Zhi.
Qinglian couldn't help but make a loud roar of fear.
"I...I...I can't betray the princess, I..."
"Sister Qinglian, how can I force others to do something difficult?"
Qinglian breathed a sigh of relief.
"This game also includes you. As long as you are the remaining four, you can survive."
Qinglian's sweet face just showed a little smile, and in an instant her face turned as white as a piece of paper.
For a moment.
There were less than ten people left, and a pair of red-eyed evil eyes were staring at Qinglian.
How can you let others take advantage of you?
